package_identity.rule: content-addressed; package_digest is computed from manifest.package_files and recorded in manifest.json and index.json, never inside a hashed package file

artifact_refs.role: author reference implementation; not independent verification

claims.claim_ceiling: ESTABLISHED means only that the supplied complete agent-runtime observation matches the supplied governed tool set under this fixture contract.
An observed alternative path can contradict exclusivity. Absence of an observed path establishes exclusivity only when path-inventory completeness is independently established.

assumptions: runtime identity is evaluated exactly as supplied by the fixture
complete=true is a fixture premise for the bounded observation, not proof of external-host completeness
tool-definition identity is represented by the supplied ToolSpec hash
explicit_non_claims: absence of host credentials or capabilities outside the observed process
absence of unobserved alternative execution paths
a second implementation is by itself an independent verification record
temporal_scope: Pinned fixture evaluation only; no live deployment time window is established.
